_meta.description: CLO/PLO attainment matrix and CQI definitions for STM31733 Network Administration

attainment_targets.description: A CLO is considered ATTAINED when at least 80% of students achieve a score of 60% or above on the mapped assessment(s)

clo_attainment.description: Identify the concepts of network administration in managing network environment
cqi_actions_if_not_met: Review lecture delivery for Unit 1.0 and 2.0 — increase use of real-world NOC case studies
Provide additional guided readings on FCAPS model and NOC team structure
Conduct revision session before Test with focus on CLO1 topic areas
Increase use of cooperative learning activities in Unit 1 and 2 topics

clo_attainment.description: Implement basic configuration for network devices in network environment
cqi_actions_if_not_met: Increase supervised Packet Tracer lab time — allocate additional practicum hours for weaker students
Provide step-by-step configuration checklists for each lab (VLAN, Routing, DHCP, DNS)
Implement peer learning — pair high-performing students with struggling ones during labs
Review Practical 1 rubric to ensure criteria are clearly communicated before the assessment
Add targeted remediation sessions for Unit 3.0 topics with low completion rates

clo_attainment.description: Perform group discussion in network monitoring traffic by using related software
cqi_actions_if_not_met: Provide structured presentation rubric to students at the start of Unit 4.0
Conduct a practice discussion session in Week 12 or 13 before the graded presentation
Use guided templates for network monitoring report structure
Assign roles within groups to ensure equitable participation (reporter, analyser, presenter)
